description.value: The Bill Putnam (Fairy Meadow) Hut is an Alpine Club of Canada backcountry hut situated at 2050m elevation in the Selkirk Mountains of British Columbia. It is a fee-based wilderness hut historically used by mountaineers and ski tourers accessing the Fairy Meadow area. Access is remote and non-motorized, making it a niche but potentially adventurous option for backcountry cyclists.
